title: ePWM
text: Generate enhanced Pulse Width Modulated (ePWM) waveforms, {ePWM#A forced (TZ) to, ePWM#B forced (TZ) to, ePWM#A forced (DCAEVT#) to, ePWM#B forced (DCBEVT#) to} sets Determines; {Allow use of 16 HRPWMs (for C28044) instead of 6 PWMs} enables HRPWM when PWM resolution is too, {Module} Indicates which ePWM module, {ePWMLink TBPRD} Indicates TBPRD linking of ePWM module Not, {Timer period units} Indicates time period units, {Specify timer period via} sets the configure source of timer period value Specify via, {Timer period} Indicates period of ePWM counter, {Timer initial period} Indicates initial ePWM period, {Active period register load option (PRDLD)} sets the event at which counter period register is reloaded Counter equals, {Counting mode} Indicates counting mode of ePWM counter, {Synchronization action} sets the source of phase, {Counting direction after phase synchronization} sets the counter direction after phase synchronization Count down after, {Phase offset value (TBPHS)}, {Specify software synchronization via input port (SWFSYNC)} Indicates phase offset value, {Enable digital compare A event1 synchronization (DCAEVT1)} sets the synchronize ePWM time based on DCAEVT1 digital compare, {Enable digital compare B event1 synchronization (DCBEVT1)} sets the synchronize ePWM time based on DCBEVT1 digital compare, {Synchronization output (SYNCO)} sets the event which generates a time base synchronization output, {Peripheral synchronization event (PWMSYNCSEL)} sets the time-Base Counter Peripheral Synchronization Counter equals, {Time base clock (TBCLK) prescaler divider}, {High speed time base clock (HSPCLKDIV) prescaler divider}, {Enable swap module A and B} sets the swap output signals for module A and B, {Enable ePWM#x} sets the enables ePWMx output signals, {Action when counter=ZERO, Action when counter=period (PRD), Action when counter=CMPA on up-count (CAU), Action when counter=CMPA on down-count (CAD), Action when counter=CMPB on up-count (CBU), Action when counter=CMPB on down-count (CBD)} determines Action Qualifier, {Add continuous software force input port, Continuous software force logic, Reload condition for software force} Determines how action-qualifier, {Inverted version of ePWM#A} sets the invert ePWM#A signal, {Enable high resolution PWM (HRPWM)} sets the enables high resolution PWM settings, {ePWMLink CMPx} sets the linking of ePWM module, {CMPx Units} sets the units used by compare registers Clock, {Specify CMPx Via} sets the pulse width source Specify, {CMPx Value/CMPx Initial Value} sets the pulse width value, {Reload for compare x Register (SHDWxMODE)} sets the time at which the counter period is reset Counter equals, {Use deadband for ePWM#A, Use deadband for ePWM#B} sets the enables deadband area, {Enable half-cycle clocking} sets the double deadband resolution, {Deadband Polarity} sets the ePWM output state at deadband time Active, {Signal source for rising edge (RED)} sets the raising edge source, {Signal source for falling edge (FED)} sets the falling edge source, {Deadband period units} Indicates deadband period units Clock, {Deadband period source} sets the source of control logic Specify, {Deadband Rising edge (RED) period (0-16383)} sets the rED delay time value, {Deadband Falling edge (FED) period} sets the fED delay time value, {Reload for DBRED register (SHDWDBRED), Reload for DBFED register (SHDWDBFED)} sets the event at which shadow register is transferred to active register Immediate without using, {Enable ADC start of conversion for module A} sets the start of ADC conversion event, {Number of event for start of conversion for Module A (SOCA) to be generated} sets the event start number, {Start of conversion for module A event selection} Indicates counter match condition that triggers ADC start of conversion event Counter equals, {Enable ADC start of conversion for module B} sets the start of ADC conversion event, {Number of event for start of conversion for Module B (SOCB) to be generated} sets the event start number, {Start of conversion for module B event selection} Indicates the counter match condition that triggers an ADC start of conversion event Counter equals, {Enable ePWM interrupt} sets the generates ePWM interrupts, {Number of event for interrupt to be generated} Specifies the number of the event that triggers the ePWM interrupt First, {Interrupt counter match event condition} Indicates the counter match condition that triggers ePWM interrupt Counter equals, {Enable High Resolution Period on ePWM#A (HRPWM - period), Enable High Resolution Period on ePWM#B (HRPWM - period)} Indicates the effective resolution for conventionally generated, {Enable HRPWM Duty on ePWM#A(HRPWM - duty)} Indicates decimal part of the compare, {High resolution PWM (HRPWM) Load mode on ePWM#A} Determines when to transfer CMPAHR shadow value to active register Counter equals, {High resolution PWM (HRPWM) control mode on ePWM#A} Indicates the control mode Duty control, {High resolution PWM (HRPWM) edge control mode} Indicates the edge control mode, {Enable high resolution deadband rising edge (RED), Enable high resolution deadband falling edge (FED)} sets the enables HRPWM capabilities on Deadband Rising Edge Delay and Falling Edge, {Use scale factor optimizer (SFO) software} Indicates scale factor, {Enable auto convert} Indicates auto convert, {Chopper module enable} sets the enables chopper module, {Chopper frequency divider} Determines frequency of chopper clock, {Chopper clock cycles width of first pulse} sets the high-energy first pulse to turn on hard and fast power, {Chopper pulse duty cycle} Determines duty cycles of second and subsequent pulses, {Trip zone source} Determines source of control logic for trip zone signals Specify via, {Enable one-shot Trip-zone# (TZ#)} sets the enables corresponding trip zone signal in one-shot, {Enable one-shot digital compare A event 1 (DCAEVT1), Enable one-shot digital compare B event 1 (DCBEVT1)} sets the enables corresponding event signal as OST trip source, {Enable cyclic Trip-zone# (TZ#)} sets the enables corresponding trip zone signal in cycle-by-cycle, {Enable cyclic digital compare A event 2 (DCAEVT2), Enable cyclic digital compare B event 2 (DCBEVT2)} sets the enables corresponding event signal as cyclic trip source, {Enable trip-zone one-shot interrupt (OST)} sets the enables trip zone one-shot interrupt, {Enable trip-zone cycle-by-cycle interrupt (CBC)} sets the enables trip-zone cycle-by-cycle interrupt, {Digital comparator output A event 1 interrupt enable (DCAEVT1), Digital comparator output A event 2 interrupt enable (DCAEVT2), Digital comparator output B event 1 interrupt enable (DCBEVT1), Digital comparator output B event 2 interrupt enable (DCBEVT2)} sets the enables digital comparator output, {Clear cycle-by-cycle trip latch at} selects clear cycle by cycle trip latch Counter equals, {Source for digital compare A high signal (DCAH), Source for digital compare B high signal (DCBH)} sets the source for digital compare high signal, {Source for digital compare A low signal (DCAL), Source for digital compare B low signal (DCBL)} sets the source for digital compare low signal, {Digital compare output A event # selection (DCAEVT#), Digital Compare output B event # selection (DCBEVT#)} sets the qualify signals that generate DC events Event, {DCAEVT# source select, DCBEVT# source select} sets the digital compare event source Event, {Pulse select} Indicates blanking window which filters out event occurrences Counter equals, {Blanking window inverted} Indicates the inverted blanking window, {Blanking window offset} Indicates offset blanking window, {Blanking window width} Indicates duration of blanking window, {Filter output DCEVTFILT} Indicates source select for filter Filtered version and {Enable counter capture} Indicates counter capture. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Allow use of 16 HRPWMs (for C28044) instead of 6 PWMs
params.values: Enable HRPWM when PWM resolution is too low off (default) | on
